name: Watch each trading node and say when it is unwell

nodes.description: the node machines to watch; every node seen by default

here.description: this machine's place name; a node here is heard by the trading node app's own heartbeat

lookback_h.description: hours back that kill rises, protection alarms and heals count

stand_down_days.description: days back that a stand-down still held is found

heartbeat_stale_after_s.description: seconds after which a node's heartbeat is late

quote_chars.description: characters of a node's outside text quoted before an ellipsis

outputs.description: a note on each node's health when it changed, landed as a proposal on the run's own ref; nothing is pressed

nodes.name: Land the note as a proposal

main.node: Land the note as a proposal
